# Introduction

<!-- Intro about the importance of Secret societies and occult movements in the history of religion, politics, and culture. -->

<!-- Hard to classify, often silo-ed knowledge and research (e.g., focusing on e.g., western esotericism, criminal organizations, etc.) -->

<!-- AI can be leveraged to identify commonalities and create a data-driven taxonomy. -->

<!-- Summary of the paper: 1) We created a open-source data-analysis friendly database of occult groups and practices, that can be accessed and visualized via a webpage as a network graph (https://dominiquemakowski.github.io/Occultopedia/). 2) We leveraged AI abilities to identify core axes of belief and practice across occult groups. 3) We back-projected each group onto these axes to create a compact conceptual space embedding of occult groups and practices. -->

# Methods

## Occultopedia - Database creation

<!-- - We started by building a database of groups, that we iteratively verified and expanded on using - when available - academic sources. -->
<!-- - We created Occultopedia (https://dominiquemakowski.github.io/Occultopedia/), a web application that allows users to explore the database as an interconnected network. -->

<!-- The idea is to have an evolutive database and reproducible analysis pipeline: the results presented in the current paper can be considered to be a 1.0 iteration, but we hope that future researchers will be able to expand and refine the database and re-run the analyses to obtain updated results. -->

# Results

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

cat(read.csv("results.csv"))

knitr::kable(read.csv("results.csv")[c("Dimension", "Summary")])

df <- read.csv("results.csv") |> 
  mutate(Concept = case_when(
# Concept: The Body (Asceticism vs. Indulgence)
    Dimension %in% c(
      "Flesh is a Trap (vs. Flesh is Divine)",
      "Ascetic Purity (vs. Carnal Indulgence)",
      "Embracing the Flesh (vs. Escaping the Prison)",
      "Asceticism (vs. Indulgence)",
      "Matter is Evil (vs. Matter is Holy)",
      "Transcendence (vs. Immanence)"
    ) ~ "Asceticism (vs. Indulgence)",
    
    # Concept: Time & Progress (Tradition vs. Futurism)
    Dimension %in% c(
      "Ancestral Blood (vs. Future Tech)",
      "Technological Futurism (vs. Ancestral Traditionalism)",
      "Ancient Myth (vs. Modern Innovation)",
      "Restoration (vs. Revolution)",
      "Biology is Destiny (vs. Technology is Destiny)",
      "Technological Salvation (vs. Natural Revelation)",
      "Biological Essentialism (vs. Constructed Identity)"
    ) ~ "Tradition (vs. Futurism)",
    
    # Concept: Law & Morality (Order vs. Chaos)
    Dimension %in% c(
      "Order through Law (vs. Power through Sin)",
      "Taboo Transgression (vs. Ascetic Purity)",
      "Order (vs. Chaos)",
      "Transgression is Good (vs. Obedience is Good)",
      "Chaos is Truth (vs. Order is Truth)"
    ) ~ "Order (vs. Chaos)",
    
    # Concept: Mode of Ritual (Rationality vs. Ecstasy)
    Dimension %in% c(
      "Rational Control (vs. Ecstatic Frenzy)",
      "Ecstatic Experience (vs. Cerebral Contemplation)",
      "Magical Theurgy (vs. Rational Science)",
      "Gnosis through Action (vs. Knowledge)",
      "Theurgy (vs. Meditation)",
      "Ecstasy is the Path (vs. Sobriety is the Path)",
      "Esoteric Gnosis (vs. Moral Philosophy)"
    ) ~ "Rationality (vs. Ecstasy)",
    
    # Concept: Methodology of Conflict (Violence vs. Pacifism)
    Dimension %in% c(
      "Violence as Tool (vs. Art as Tool)",
      "Violent Subversion (vs. Peaceful Elite)",
      "Kinetic Violence (vs. Intellectual Gnosis)",
      "Sacred Violence (vs. Sacred Peace)",
      "Violence (vs. Pacifism)",
      "Violence is Sacred (vs. Study is Sacred)"
    ) ~ "Violence (vs. Pacifism)",
    
    # Concept: Organizational Structure (Hierarchy vs. Decentralization)
    Dimension %in% c(
      "Centralized Guru (vs. Distributed Cell)",
      "Decentralized Chaos (vs. Rigid Hierarchy)",
      "Hierarchy (vs. Decentralization)",
      "The Guru is God (vs. The Network is God)",
      "The Few Should Rule (vs. The Many Should Rule)"
    ) ~ "Hierarchy (vs. Decentralization)",
    
    # Concept: The Self (Individualism vs. Collectivism)
    Dimension %in% c(
      "Self-Deification (vs. Total Submission)",
      "Communal Living (vs. Individual Autonomy)",
      "Self-Deification (vs. Hive-Mind Submission)",
      "Individual Apotheosis (vs. Collective Salvation)"
    ) ~ "Individualism (vs. Collectivism)",
    
    # Concept: Visibility (Secrecy vs. Spectacle)
    Dimension %in% c(
      "Invisible Influence (vs. Public Spectacle)",
      "Theatrical Spectacle (vs. Hermetic Secrecy)",
      "Exoteric Performance (vs. Esoteric Concealment)"
    ) ~ "Secrecy (vs. Spectacle)",
    
    # Concept: Societal Orientation (Subversion vs. Establishment)
    Dimension %in% c(
      "Political Domination (vs. Cosmic Escape)",
      "Infiltration (vs. Withdrawal)",
      "Subversion (vs. Establishment)",
      "Overthrow the State (vs. Preserve the State)"
    ) ~ "Subversion (vs. Establishment)",
    
    # Concept: Gender Dynamics
    Dimension %in% c(
      "Gender Fluidity (vs. Male Exclusivity)",
      "Gender Fluidity (vs. Exclusivity)"
    ) ~ "Gender Inclusivity (vs. Exclusivity)",
    
    # Concept: Eschatology (Apocalyptic vs. Cyclic)
    Dimension %in% c(
      "Apocalyptic End (vs. Eternal Cycle)",
      "Apocalyptic Acceleration (vs. Cosmic Maintenance)"
    ) ~ "Apocalyptic (vs. Cyclic)",

    .default = Dimension
         )) 


# Check
summarize(df, n_Dims = n_distinct(Dimension), n_Concepts = n_distinct(Concept), .by = c("Model", "Iteration"))
filter(df, Model == "Grok Expert" & Iteration == 1)
```

```{r}
# Preprocess
df <- df |> 
  summarize(Importance = mean(Importance), .by = c("Model", "Iteration", "Concept")) |>
  mutate(Importance = as.numeric(Importance), 
         Concept = fct_reorder(Concept, desc(Importance), .fun = mean)) 


# Filter rare
to_remove <- as.data.frame(table(df$Concept)) |> 
  filter(Freq < 2) |> 
  pull(Var1)
df <- filter(df, !(Concept %in% to_remove))



# Plot
bootmean_ci <- function(x, quantile = 0.025) {
  boot_means <- replicate(1000, {
    sample_x <- sample(x, size = length(x), replace = TRUE)
    mean(sample_x, na.rm = TRUE)
  })
  quantile(boot_means, quantile, na.rm = TRUE)
}

dfdims <- df |> 
  summarise(Concept = unique(Concept),
            CI_low = bootmean_ci(Importance, 0.025),
            CI_high = bootmean_ci(Importance, 0.975),
            Importance = mean(Importance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .by = "Concept")

df |> 
  mutate(group = paste(Iteration, Model)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Concept, y = Importance)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = group, color = Model)) +
  geom_ribbon(data = dfdims, aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high, group = 1), fill = "grey", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = dfdims, aes(group = 1), color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) 
```
